transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I just... I've been having a hard time lately. I feel like I can't settle down. It's like my own skin is too tight or something. I just always feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing, even when I'm completely worn out and know I should just be sitting still.
Do you ever get sudden surges of intense fear or physical panic that peak within minutes?
No... not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't get scared, just... what I mentioned before.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or wired for days at a time?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't get... wired like that for days. It's just a constant feeling, not a special period of time.
Did this restless feeling start after you began using any drug, alcohol, or medication?
No, I... I haven't started taking anything new. It's not from that.
Did you have this same kind of hard-to-sit-still restlessness when you were a child?

I suppose... yes. Even back in grade school. The teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright but... careless. I was always losing papers, or... talking out of turn. They had to keep reminding me to stay in my seat and just... finish my work. So... yes. It's always been like that.
Do you often have trouble finishing tasks because your mind wanders or you get distracted?

Yes... I do. I help with a quilting charity, and... well, if someone gives me three or four things to do, I might start the first one right away. But then... I just wander into another chore. The last steps just never get done.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about many different everyday things?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, like anyone, but... not excessively. Just normal things, I suppose.
